title: Molecular configuration graphs, reaction paths and exact barriers
description:
Complete molecular configuration paths, exact basin and barrier decisions, and all fifty experimental ethanol torsion rows.

Maria Smith proves retention of every node and neighbour comparison at arbitrary finite path extension, complete classification and uniqueness across the original 256-candidate grammar, exact ground and excited state order, and intermediate-state retention in reaction composition. Both complete torsion paths yield six basins, six barriers and thirty-six ordinary nodes. Includes explicit mathematical arguments, 501 distinct empty-axiom audited declarations, pinned V3 and V4 sources, and portable reproduction.
